user.title: Connect to Nexprint
user.description: Choose how you want to sign in to your Nexprint account.

password.title: Sign in with Email & Password
password.description: Enter your Elegoo / Nexprint credentials. First-time Nexprint users must accept the initial authorization prompt on nexprint.com in a browser first.

data.accept_terms: I have read and agree to the Nexprint Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

token.title: Sign in with Session Token
token.description: Paste the access_token (and optional refresh_token) captured from nexprint.com.

data.accept_terms: I have read and agree to the Nexprint Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach nexprint.com (check network or VPN routing).
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, expired token, or first-time authorization not yet accepted on nexprint.com.
error.terms_not_accepted: You must agree to the Nexprint Terms of Use and Privacy Policy to sign in.

abort.already_configured: This Nexprint account is already configured.
